items.title: Cache Engineering for Agents
items.summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage become the dominant cost. Trajectories can also exceed the LLM's maximum context length, requiring control over active cache growth. Prior work uses context engineering to reduce cache size by trimming or summarizing history. However, modifying the trajectory prefix invalidates subsequent cached states and triggers costly re-prefilling of retained context. Task accuracy can also suffer when too little context is retained to limit re-prefill costs. We propose cache engineering as a new scheme. It allows agents to directly control their active KV cache without modifying the trajectory or re-prefilling retained context. Specifically, agents can proactively use drop to exclude selected cache from future attention and repos to adjust retained keys' position encodings. We formalize these cache operations and identify history dependence as a serving challenge: identical token sequences can yield different cache states under different cache operation sequences, making prefix matching insufficient for correct cache reuse. Thus, we co-design the AKV serving engine. It provides a stateless interface compatible with existing serving APIs, while internally managing stateful cache reuse, eviction, and restoration. Experiments show that a tool-response rolling-drop cache policy improves average be…
items.summary_zh: 针对大语言模型智能体在长轨迹中KV缓存成本高的问题，提出一种直接控制缓存的新方案。通过主动丢弃和位置编码调整，该方案无需修改轨迹即可管理缓存，并设计了AKV服务引擎。

items.title: SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?
items.summary: Spatial intelligence requires agents to actively acquire visual evidence and integrate observations into a coherent representation of the three-dimensional world. Yet spatial question answering offers limited evidence of whether models can construct accurate metric maps through autonomous exploration. We introduce SpatialScout, a benchmark for evaluating vision-language model (VLM) agents on active object-level 3D mapping. SpatialScout comprises 80 diverse indoor scenes containing 3,140 target objects. Given an object inventory, RGB observations, camera calibration, and camera poses, agents control a camera to explore each scene and estimate object centers in a shared coordinate frame. The task requires coordinating viewpoint selection, cross-view association, geometric estimation, and map revision under bounded interaction budgets. Evaluation jointly measures localization accuracy and target coverage through object-scale overlap scores that penalize missing predictions. Experiments with frontier VLMs reveal substantial limitations: the strongest evaluated model, Claude Opus 5.5, achieves a mean overlap score of 41.71%, with 47.23% of targets exceeding an intersection-over-union (IoU) threshold of 0.5 and only 3.25% exceeding 0.9. These results reveal a substantial gap between recovering coarse object layouts and constructing complete, precise metric maps. SpatialScout provides a quantitative testbed for developing agents that build reliable 3D spatial representations throug…
items.title_zh: SpatialScout：VLM智能体能主动探索并映射3D场景吗？
items.summary_zh: 为评估视觉语言模型智能体在主动物体级3D映射中的能力，构建了包含80个室内场景和3140个目标物体的基准SpatialScout。实验表明，最强模型在目标覆盖率和定位精度上仍存在显著局限。

items.title: PAR: Progress-Aligned Recurrence for Length Generalization in State Tracking
items.summary: Looped language models can run more iterations at test time, but additional iterations need not help them solve longer problems. For sequential state tracking, final-answer supervision does not specify how far each iteration should advance, and repeated updates can change the scale of the recurrent state. We introduce Progress-Aligned Recurrence (PAR), which trains the prediction at iteration k to match the state after the first k operations and rescales recurrent states to their first-iteration norms. On swap-S_5, a Qwen2.5-0.5B model trained on at most 32 moves achieves 95.5\% mean full-state accuracy at 512 moves, or 16times the training length, compared with 55.7\% reported for RLT and 0.8\% for explicit chain of thought on the same backbone. Controlled S_5 ablations show that removing norm anchoring reduces the extrapolation factor from 16times to below 2.2times, and replacing progress-aligned targets with final-answer supervision reduces it to at most 8times. A learned completion readout selects when to answer without a supplied stopping depth. When intermediate labels are unavailable, prefix self-distillation induces the correspondence from shorter problem prefixes using only final answers. The gains apply across sequential state-tracking tasks, establishing the task structure required for depth extrapolation. These findings support training intermediate predictions and state scale together to make additional recurrent depth useful for longer problems.
items.title_zh: PAR：状态跟踪中的长度泛化对齐递归
items.summary_zh: 为解决循环语言模型在长序列状态跟踪中重复更新导致状态尺度变化的问题，提出对齐递归（PAR）。该方法通过训练预测与状态匹配并重置状态尺度，在Qwen2.5-0.5B模型上实现了16倍长度外推。

items.title: MemT-1.0: Towards Memory-Native Evolution
items.summary: Memory-native evolution requires making memory an intrinsic capability of foundation models, enabling them to continuously accumulate and utilize information. To this end, we introduce MemT-1.0, a new architecture of memory foundation models that internalize memory as part of model computation. Building on Metis, MemT-1.0 employs Gated DeltaNet-2 with a stable token-level memory update mechanism within each turn. We further introduce Mixture-of-Storage to scale native memory capacity. Following a deliberate backbone preparation, we develop a two-stage training pipeline consisting of continued pre-training and post-training, supported by 34B tokens of training data and efficient training and inference infrastructure. We release a model family comprising MemT-1.0-Nano and MemT-1.0-Flash, and conduct a comprehensive evaluation of memory and general capabilities. The results show that they outperform the parametric memory baselines on average and remain competitive with retrieval-augmented methods, while largely preserving general capabilities. At a history length of 128K tokens, MemT-1.0-Nano achieves approximately 1.86times end-to-end inference speedup and a 66times reduction in persistent storage relative to full context KV cache. By internalizing retrieved procedural experience, MemT-1.0 improves task success on agentic tasks, providing a practical step toward memory-native evolution.
items.summary_zh: 为使基础模型具备持续积累和利用信息的能力，提出MemT-1.0架构，将记忆内化为模型计算的一部分。该模型通过混合存储机制扩展原生记忆容量，在128K历史长度下实现了推理加速和存储减少。

items.title: Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR Technical Report
items.summary: We present Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR, a family of audio-language models that builds upon its predecesor Qwen-Audio-3.0-ASR with improved speech recognition and expanded capabilities in speaker-diarized transcription and general audio understanding. The family retains support for 30 languages and 16 Chinese dialects, together with instruction-controlled capabilities including historical-context conditioning, hierarchical hotword customization, and native transcription polishing. Speaker-diarized ASR produces structured outputs containing speaker labels, timestamps, and recognized text, maintaining consistent speaker labels across turns and the representation of overlapping speech. The general audio understanding capabilities cover audio-, speech-, and music-captioning, temporal grounding and sound event detection, as well as audio question answering and multiple-choice reasoning. These tasks broaden the application scope from recognizing spoken words to interpreting speakers, acoustic events, and their temporal relations. To accommodate different deployment requirements, the family includes variants for asynchronous file transcription, low-latency streaming, interactive voice input, and non-streaming recognition, with speaker-diarized transcription and general audio understanding available in certain variants. Evaluations span conventional ASR, multilingual and dialectal speech, speaker-diarized transcription, and general audio understanding, demonstrating the capabilities of the Qw…

5f9fee032323.body: Anthropic 发布 Claude Duet，能主动发现任务并提醒用户，关键操作需批准。

3517f80a1ebb.headline: firecrawl：AI 智能体网络数据抓取库
3517f80a1ebb.body: firecrawl 为 AI 智能体提供来自网络的数据抓取能力。

48f69673aab6.headline: LangSmith LLM Gateway 公测
48f69673aab6.body: LangSmith LLM Gateway 公测，提供配额限制、模型回退等功能。

743ba1238b9b.headline: Qwen-code 发布 0.26.0 版本
743ba1238b9b.body: Qwen-code v0.26.0 发布，支持会话目标技能刷新、会话创建预热等功能。

91ca63d72279.headline: Cache Engineering for Agents：智能体缓存工程

33d7860e4312.headline: SpatialScout：VLM 智能体 3D 场景映射

f871ea528f53.headline: Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR技术报告
f871ea528f53.body: Qwen团队发布Qwen-Audio-3.1-ASR，支持30种语言和16种中文方言，增强语音识别和通用音频理解能力。
